turns.text: Lloyd, quick question on the architecture doc. I'm finalizing the spec for Per-User Memory Architecture.
Sure Alan. What's the primary focus for this version?
It's all about identity. Specifically, Per-User Memory Architecture is designed to support cross-surface identity resolution for users across MC, Discord, Voice, and Signal.
Got it. So it's a unified view across those four surfaces.
Exactly. By the way, did you see the weather? It's pouring again in Seattle.
It has been pretty relentless. I hope you're staying dry.
I'm inside. Just trying to get this diagram right before the lunch rush.
Hey Lloyd, I'm looking at the implementation details now. It's going well.
Glad to hear it. Have you populated the test data?
Yes, I just updated the config. registry.json contains entries for users like Alan and Lisa with their identifiers across surfaces.
That sounds good. Are the IDs matching the expected format?
They seem fine. I had to reorder some JSON keys, though.
Standard formatting issues. Did you get that new keyboard you ordered?
No, still stuck in transit. It's annoying.
Maybe it'll arrive by the weekend.
